verdict.rationale: Poke is a hosted AI assistant service, so choosing where data is stored (region or residency) is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options or data location controls. The Telegram/WhatsApp regional availability note concerns messaging-channel access, not where data is stored, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
